inputs.text: An Indiana judge blocked a law restricting abortion after the ACLU and Hoosier Jews for Choice argued it burdened people’s ability to follow their sincerely held religious beliefs. That’s a crucial check on state power: no government should impose one religious or political worldview by restricting people’s bodily autonomy and access to care. These restrictions fall hardest on people with the fewest resources and choices. LifeNews.com’s “killing babies” language is inflammatory framing, not a serious engagement with religious freedom or the real consequences of denying care.
